# SKN Industries

> SKN Industries is a leading manufacturer and supplier of corrugated boxes, wooden pallets, industrial packaging products, and export packaging solutions for domestic and international industries.

## Website
https://www.sknindustries.com/

## Company Information
Company Name: SKN Industries  
Industry: Packaging and Industrial Manufacturing  
Country: India  
Language: English (en)

## About Company
SKN Industries specializes in manufacturing high-quality corrugated boxes, wooden pallets, packaging boxes, industrial packaging materials, and customized packaging solutions for multiple industries. The company serves domestic and export markets with durable and cost-effective packaging products.

## Core Products & Services
- Corrugated Boxes
- Corrugated Packaging Solutions
- Wooden Pallets
- Wooden Packaging Boxes
- Industrial Packaging Materials
- Export Packaging Solutions
- PET Strapping
- Packaging Tapes
- Packaging Tools
- Heavy Duty Packaging Solutions
